quantity_policy: Quantity comparisons allow max(1e-7,8 binary64 ULPs), capped at 1% of the smaller of official order lot and minimum observed positive fill size. No price/PnL/identifier/time tolerance; no source quantity is rewritten.
average_entry_scope: Local-history recoveries: theoretical weighted cost from a zero/reversal anchor, quantity links and continuous source coverage. Third-party recoveries: pre-fill as-of reconstructed position averages independently returned by 0xArchive and checked against native execution identity, size and close PnL. Distinct methods are labeled per row. Neither asserts an official historical ledger entryPx lookup.

trump_export.limitations: CSV has second-level timestamps and no markPx/startPosition/native trade ID; it cannot directly supply the missing raw liquidation mark.

next_export.observed_message: Your IP address has reached the daily export limit (1 export per 24 hours).

legacy_side_assignment_sample.matching_keys: user/coin/time/hash/px/sz/startPosition/compatible oid; candidate side deliberately excluded from the join

api_query_interpretation: Zero historical rows are missing-data evidence, not proof of no historical activity; full pages and historical retention limits are not complete coverage.

notebook_execution.method: Sequential standard CPython execution, captured stdout

local_full_cost_window_terminal_check.scope: Existing signature-verified canonical sources from the selected anchor or local archive floor through each unfilled target.
